Name: Rainbow Animated Galaxy Sword
Author: dunnisimtrouble
Description:
[i]
Hey Guys! :) I noticed that the galaxy sword looked very unlike what I imagined it to be and so I wanted to make this retro-esque flashing animated Galaxy Sword with the colours from the prismatic shard, I hope you all like it! Share to someone who may :)
